```{r packages,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
library(tidyverse)
library(DescTools)
library(MatchIt)
library(cobalt)
```

```{r read_data,include=FALSE}
working_path='~/Dropbox/data_quickpay/qp_replication/working/'
reg_df_subset=fread(paste0(working_path,
                 'w_clean_control.csv'))
```

```{r contractor_capability, include=FALSE}

# Number of projects with positive delay before QuickPay

delay_before_qp=reg_df_subset[post_t==0 & delay>0][,
                         .(num_projs_delayed=n_distinct(contract_award_unique_key)),
                       by='recipient_duns']


num_proj_before_qp=reg_df_subset[post_t==0][,
                         .(num_projs=n_distinct(contract_award_unique_key)),
                       by='recipient_duns']

contractor_capability=merge(delay_before_qp,
                            num_proj_before_qp,
         by='recipient_duns',
         all.y=T)

contractor_capability=contractor_capability[!is.na(recipient_duns)]
# Set na values for num_projs_delayed to be zero 
contractor_capability[is.na(contractor_capability)]=0
contractor_capability[,frac_delayed:=num_projs_delayed/num_projs]
```


```{r merge_with_reg, include=FALSE}
reg_df_subset[, two_digit_psc:=substr(product_or_service_code,1,2)]
reg_df_subset[, two_digit_naics:=substr(naics_code,1,2)]

reg_df_subset=merge(reg_df_subset,
                    contractor_capability[,c('recipient_duns',
                                             'frac_delayed')],
                    by='recipient_duns',
                    all.x=T)
```


```{r matching, include=FALSE}
set.seed(190)

input=na.omit(reg_df_subset,
                            cols=c('product_or_service_code',
                                'awarding_sub_agency_code',
                                'naics_code',
                                'wins_project_quarter_stage',
                                'wins_number_of_offers_received',
                                'winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i',
                                'winsorized_initial_budget_i',
                                'frac_delayed'))

m.out=matchit(treat_new~frac_delayed+
                as.factor(awarding_sub_agency_code)+
                                  as.factor(two_digit_naics)+
                                  as.factor(action_date_year_quarter)+
                                  winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i+
                                  winsorized_initial_budget_i+
                                  wins_number_of_offers_received,
                                data=input,
                                cutpoints= list(frac_delayed=5,
                                                winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i = 5,
                                                winsorized_initial_budget_i = 5,
                                                wins_number_of_offers_received=5),
                                method='cem')

df=match.data(m.out)

df[,wins_percentage_delay:=100*Winsorize(percentage_delay,probs=c(0.025,0.975),na.rm=T)]
df[,winsorized_delay:=Winsorize(delay,probs=c(0.025,0.975),na.rm=T)]
m=feols(wins_percentage_delay~treat_new+
                            post_t:treat_new+
                            log(wins_project_quarter_stage)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            wins_number_of_offers_received+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            post_t:wins_number_of_offers_received|
                            naics_code+product_or_service_code+action_date_year_quarter,
                          data=df, 
                          weights=~weights,
                          cluster=~contract_award_unique_key)
```

```{r}
bal.plot(m.out, 
         var.name = "frac_delayed", 
                  which = "both", 
                  mirror = TRUE,
         type = "histogram", 
         colors = c("lightgray", "black"),
         sample.names = 
             c("Unmatched Sample", "Matched Sample"))+
  xlab("Fraction of pre-QP projects delayed")+
  ggtitle("")
```

```{r positive_delay_setup, include=FALSE}
reg_df_subset[,positive_delay:=ifelse(delay>0,1,0)]

reg_df_subset_positive=subset(reg_df_subset,delay>0)
reg_df_subset_positive[,wins_percentage_delay:=Winsorize(100*percentage_delay,                    
                              probs=c(0.05,0.95),
                              na.rm=T)]

reg_df_subset_positive[,wins_project_quarter_stage:=Winsorize(project_quarter_stage,
                                                              probs=c(0.05,0.95),
                                na.rm=T)]

reg_df_subset_positive[,winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i:=
                    Winsorize(initial_duration_in_days_i,
                    probs=c(0.05,0.95),
                    na.rm=T)]

# InitialBudget_i
reg_df_subset_positive[,winsorized_initial_budget_i:=
                    Winsorize(base_and_all_options_value,                    
                              probs=c(0.05,0.95),
                              na.rm=T)]

reg_df_subset_positive[,wins_number_of_offers_received:=
                    Winsorize(number_of_offers_received,                    
                              probs=c(0.05,0.95),
                              na.rm=T)]
```

```{r positive_delay_logit, include=FALSE}
m1=feglm(positive_delay~treat_new+
                            post_t:treat_new+
                            log(wins_project_quarter_stage)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            wins_number_of_offers_received+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            post_t:wins_number_of_offers_received|
                            action_date_year_quarter,
                            family='binomial',
                            cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
                          data=reg_df_subset)

m2=feglm(positive_delay~treat_new+
                            post_t:treat_new+
                            log(wins_project_quarter_stage)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            wins_number_of_offers_received+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            post_t:wins_number_of_offers_received|
                            product_or_service_code+action_date_year_quarter,
                            family='binomial',
                            cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
                          data=reg_df_subset)

m3=feglm(positive_delay~treat_new+
                            post_t:treat_new+
                            log(wins_project_quarter_stage)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            wins_number_of_offers_received+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)+
                            post_t:log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)+
                            post_t:wins_number_of_offers_received|
                            naics_code+product_or_service_code+action_date_year_quarter,
                            family='binomial',
                            cluster=~contract_award_unique_key,
                          data=reg_df_subset)

positive_delay_logit=list(m1,m2,m3)
```

```{r output, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
setFixest_dict(dict=c("wins_percentage_delay"="Percent delay rate",
                      "positive_delay"="Log odds (Delay rate >0)",
                      "post_t"="Post",
                      "treat_new"="Treat",
                      "log(wins_project_quarter_stage)"="Project stage",
                      "log(1+winsorized_initial_duration_in_days_i)"="Initial duration",
                      "log(1+winsorized_initial_budget_i)"="Initial budget",
                      "wins_number_of_offers_received"="Number of offers",
                      "contract_award_unique_key"="Project ID",
                      "product_or_service_code"="Task",
                      "action_date_year_quarter"="Time",
                      "naics_code"="Industry",
                      "awarding_sub_agency_code"="Subagency"
                      ))


etable(delay_rates,
       stage_post,
       no_post_interaction,
       digits='r2',
       digits.stats = 2,
       fontsize = "small",
       title="Baseline diff-in-diff effect",
       headers=list("Excluding Stage $\\times Post_t$"=length(delay_rates),
                    "Including Stage $\\times Post_t$"=length(stage_post),
                    "Excluding X $\\times Post_t$"=length(no_post_interaction)),
       fitstat = c("pr2","n","r2"),
       drop=c("Project stage",
              "Initial duration",
              "Initial budget",
              "Number of offers"),
       style.tex=style.tex(fixef.title = "",
                           fixef.suffix = " FE",
                           var.title = "\\midrule ",
                           depvar.title = "",
                           model.title = "",
                           stats.title = "",
                           model.format = "I",
                           yesNo = c("Yes","No"),
                           line.bottom="simple",
                           line.top="simple"),
       notes="Controls include Log(project stage), Log(1+initial duration), Log(1+initial budget), and number of bids. Log(1+initial duration), Log(1+initial budget), and number of bids are also interacted with Post are also included as controls",
       tex=TRUE)
       
etable(delay_rates,
       positive_delay_logit,
       conditional_delay_rates,
       digits='r2',
       digits.stats = 2,
       fontsize = "small",
       title="Baseline diff-in-diff effect",
       headers=list("Average treatment effect"=length(delay_rates),
                    "Delay likelihood and conditional ATE"=length(positive_delay_logit)+
                                                           length(conditional_delay_rates)),
       fitstat = c("pr2","n","r2"),
       drop=c("Project stage",
              "Initial duration",
              "Initial budget",
              "Number of offers"),
       style.tex=style.tex(fixef.title = "",
                           fixef.suffix = " FE",
                           var.title = "\\midrule ",
                           depvar.title = "",
                           model.title = "",
                           stats.title = "",
                           model.format = "I",
                           yesNo = c("Yes","No"),
                           line.bottom="simple",
                           line.top="simple"),
       notes="Controls include Log(project stage), Log(1+initial duration), Log(1+initial budget), and number of bids. Log(1+initial duration), Log(1+initial budget), and number of bids are also interacted with Post are also included as controls",
       tex=TRUE)
```
